dispatches.text: March, AD 68. Word comes from Gaul: Julius Vindex, governor of Lugdunensis, has risen against Nero.
XI Claudia takes your promises.
Julius Vindex, governor of Lugdunensis, raises the Gauls against Nero.
Dalmatia is yours.
At Hispania Tarraconensis, the old governor Servius Sulpicius Galba lets his men hail him: legate of the Senate and People, he says, not yet emperor.
Titus Arrius, legate of V Macedonica, claims the purple in Judaea.
Quintus Vibius swears to you when your province falls: a legate of one of your legions. He can command an army for you.
A truce is agreed between Gaius Julius Vindex and you.
Nero's exiles come home and get their estates back. Their families remember who did it.
In Africa, Clodius Macer, legate of III Augusta, holds back the grain ships and raises a legion of his own.
An alliance is agreed between Titus Arrius and Lucius Clodius Macer.
Your legions hail you as imperator.
Nero is dead. Abandoned by the Praetorians, he took his own life outside Rome. The Senate rules, for now.
Quintus Numisius, legate of XXII Deiotariana, claims the purple in Aegyptus.
A truce is agreed between Quintus Numisius and Servius Sulpicius Galba.
Titus Arrius has lost his last legion. His cause is finished.
The Senate names you legate of the Senate and People of Rome.
The Senate declares Quintus Numisius a public enemy of the Roman people.
A truce is agreed between Gaius Julius Vindex and Lucius Clodius Macer.
Gnaeus Annius, legate of V Alaudae, claims the purple in Germania Inferior.
The Senate declares Gnaeus Annius a public enemy of the Roman people.
A trade agreement is made between Lucius Clodius Macer and Gaius Julius Vindex. Merchants cross the lines.
Publius Arrius, legate of III Gallica, claims the purple in Moesia.
Battle near Tarraco: Lucius Clodius Macer wins against Servius Sulpicius Galba.
Dalmatia: your men are beaten against a walled town.
On the Rhine, the legions refuse their oath and hail Aulus Vitellius emperor.
Marcus Salvius Otho, once Nero's friend, buys the Praetorians and claims the throne.
An alliance is agreed between Gaius Julius Vindex and Marcus Salvius Otho.
A truce is agreed between Aulus Vitellius and you.
A truce is agreed between Marcus Salvius Otho and you.
The Senate votes you proconsular imperium: your command is now lawful in their eyes.
The Roxolani cross the frozen Danube into Moesia.
Marcus Vipstanus, legate of XII Fulminata, claims the purple in Syria.
The trade between Lucius Clodius Macer and Gaius Julius Vindex ends with the peace.
Pannonia: your men are beaten against a walled town.
A truce is agreed between Gnaeus Annius and you.
An alliance is agreed between Publius Arrius and you.
Vologases sends envoys and gifts to Marcus Vipstanus: friendship, and the caravans of the East.
A truce is agreed between Gnaeus Annius and Aulus Vitellius.
An alliance is agreed between Publius Arrius and Marcus Salvius Otho.
An alliance is agreed between Gaius Julius Vindex and you.
Sohaemus of Emesa sends 3000 men to Quintus Numisius.
Servius Sulpicius Galba falls back from Hispania Tarraconensis rather than fight Lucius Clodius Macer.
Publius Arrius buys VII Claudia.
Publius Arrius buys VIII Augusta.
In Britain, Venutius leads the Brigantes in revolt.
Aulus Cornelius, legate of XX Valeria Victrix, claims the purple in Britannia.
On the eve of battle, V Macedonica goes over to Servius Sulpicius Galba.
Battle near Roma: night falls with neither army broken. Quintus Numisius draws off.
A trade agreement is made between Gnaeus Annius and you. Merchants cross the lines.
A truce is agreed between Aulus Vitellius and Servius Sulpicius Galba.
Aulus Plotius swears to you. He can command an army for you.
At Alexandria, the legions of the East hail Titus Flavius Vespasianus emperor. The last act begins.
Temple of the imperial cult finished in Gallia Lugdunensis.
Granaries finished in Gallia Narbonensis.
Vologases sends envoys and gifts to Titus Flavius Vespasianus: friendship, and the caravans of the East.
On the Rhine, the Batavian prince Julius Civilis stirs his people.
An alliance is agreed between Titus Flavius Vespasianus and Marcus Salvius Otho.
V Alaudae joins the army at Germania Superior.
New legion of Germania Inferior joins the army at Germania Superior.
New legion of Gallia Belgica joins the army at Germania Superior.
New legion of Gallia Belgica joins the army at Germania Superior.
Temple of the imperial cult finished in Alpes Maritimae.
Aulus Vitellius buys I Italica.
II Augusta joins the army at Germania Inferior.
IX Hispana joins the army at Germania Inferior.
XX Valeria Victrix joins the army at Germania Inferior.
Your army falls back from Gallia Narbonensis before the enemy, its rearguard fighting.
Your army falls back from Gallia Lugdunensis before the enemy, its rearguard fighting.
Temple of the imperial cult finished in Alpes Cottiae.
A trade agreement is made between Servius Sulpicius Galba and Aulus Vitellius. Merchants cross the lines.
A truce is agreed between Titus Flavius Vespasianus and Servius Sulpicius Galba.
Gallic levy joins the army at Germania Inferior.
New legion of Gallia Lugdunensis joins the army at Germania Inferior.
Your army falls back from Gallia Narbonensis before the enemy, its rearguard fighting.
The trade between Servius Sulpicius Galba and Aulus Vitellius ends with the peace.
The Garamantes raid the coast of Africa.
A trade agreement is made between Marcus Salvius Otho and Titus Flavius Vespasianus. Merchants cross the lines.
Gallia Narbonensis: your men are beaten against the garrison.
Gallia Narbonensis: your men are beaten against a walled town.
Gallia Narbonensis: your men are beaten against a walled town.

storyLog.title: An accuser in the Senate
storyLog.text: He is acquitted. The accuser will look for an easier victim.

storyLog.title: A letter from Rome
storyLog.text: Your name is spoken kindly in the curia.

storyLog.title: Pirates
storyLog.choice: Let the merchants look after themselves
storyLog.text: Freight rates double. Fewer ships sail.

storyLog.title: The veterans
storyLog.text: A new colony of old soldiers. The locals are not asked.

storyLog.title: The Arval Brothers
storyLog.text: The priests wait to see who wins.

storyLog.title: A legate offers his sword
storyLog.text: He swears by Jupiter and by your genius.

storyLog.title: A centurion is killed
storyLog.text: The lots are drawn. Nobody forgets it.

storyLog.title: The centurions come
storyLog.text: They will remember the promise, and the day it falls due.

storyLog.title: The merchants' petition
storyLog.choice: Halve the tolls for six months
storyLog.text: More ships put in at your harbours.
